entries.name: On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Blade)

system.description:
As a Bonus Action, swap squares with an adjacent or diagonally adjacent unit. If the targeted unit is not allied to you, you must first pass a Finesse check (DC 4 + target's Agi).

The target must be the same size as the user. If the target is airborne, the user must be able to reach it in melee.
Swordsmen make it their mission to excel at the use of Blade weapons.

An excellent, double-edged sword. The gold standard for experienced swordsmen. 

 Heavybreaker, Brawlbreaker. +1 Eva while equipped.
If this unit is wielding a Blade weapon, melee attacks that Miss against them cause the attacker to suffer 2 Brk damage.
